title: Local Fashion Luxury Shopping With A Style Coach
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
May be operated by a multi-lingual guide
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover Montreal’s finest high end and luxury designers and their unleashed creative potential. Take a dive into the city's fashion history and learn about its unique fashion scene from your guide while exploring the creative DNA of Montreal's wearable art makers. The 5 hour adventure will take you off the beaten path through a personalized fashion and style experience.
Get a mini style consultation with your style coach and discover which colors and cuts are best for your personal features and what style strategy we recommend based on your objectives. You will be provided with your personal style strategy notes and our shopping tour tote filled with little surprises.
